test_title: All India SSC MTS & Havaldar 2025: Marks Booster Mega Live Test - 04
subject: general
question: A boat covers a distance of 1 km against the current of the stream in half an hour and a distance of 3 km in the direction of the current in 30 minutes. How long will it take for the boat to go 8 km in still water?
solution:
**Given:**

Distance against current = 1 km

Time taken to travel against current = 30 min = 0.5 hour

Distance in the direction of the current = 3 km

Time taken in the direction of the current = 30 min = 0.5 hour

**Formula used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

Upstream speed (U) = V - S

Downstream speed (D) = V + S

Where, V = Speed of boat in still water, S = Speed of current

**Calculation:**

Upstream speed (U) = 1/0.5 = 2 km/hour

⇒ V - S = 2 -----(1)

Downstream speed = 3/0.5 = 6 km/hour

⇒ V + S = 6 -----(2) 

Adding equation(1) to equation(2)

⇒ 2V = 8

⇒ V = 8/2 = 4 km/hour

So, speed of boat in still water = 4 km/hour

Time to travel 8 km in still water = 8/4 = 2 hours

**∴ Boat will go 8 km in still water in 2 hours.**
